notes.title: The Steam Summer Sale is On! 🏖
notes.content:
[h3][b]STEAM SUMMER SALE[/b][/h3]
🌊🏖🌴Jump into some refreshingly cool savings during the Steam Summer Sale, like 70% off the adorable but challenging action-RPG, Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure! This is the deepest discount Gurumin has ever seen on Steam, so don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!

If shooters and warm tropical nights are more your thing, then things are really gonna' heat up when you see that the Heavy Fire + Reload Triple Pack is 75% off! 💥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/Gurumin_A_Monstrous_Adventure/
 
https://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/


[h3][b]NEW PUBLISHER PAGE[/b][/h3]
Check out the brand new [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/mastiff/]Mastiff Publisher Page[/url][/b] right here on Steam for all of the tasty deals going down right now through July 8.

And please be sure to follow us on Steam and on your favorite social media platforms for the latest news, deals, and giveaways! 😏🎁

PROTIP: Follow us on the the [url=https://twitter.com/mastiffgames/]Mastiff Twitter[/url] account today for giveaways going down TODAY and TOMORROW!

[h3][b]NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT[/b][/h3]
We recently announced that we'll be working with MeNic Games to publish their toy city-builder Tinytopia! 🏗🏨🏙

The game is a 'toy-tal' blast to play! (That pun didn't really work, did it? Well, we tried. 😅)
Please check out the Tinytopia Steam store page and add it to your Wishlist today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/968550/Tinytopia/

notes.title: Lunar New Year Sale & Your Chance to WIN a $25 Gift Card!
notes.content:
[b]Happy Lunar Near Year, everyone![/b] :lunar2019wavingpig:

We hope that everyone has been having a wonderful year thus far, and that your holidays were filled with fun and cheer! 

We may be a little late to making this here sale announcement, but let's instead consider the sale news to be arriving fashionably late. Yeah, that sounds good...let's roll with that. 

[h1][b]Steam Lunar New Year Sale![/b][/h1]
Aside from being able to pick up Reload for a steal-of-a-deal price (81% off), we also have a few other titles on sale too...like the on-rails action-shooter series, Heavy Fire. Right now both [i]Heavy Fire: Shattered Spear[/i] and [i]Heavy Fire: Afghanistan[/i] are on sale during the Lunar New Year Sale. The plucky action RPG, [i]Gurumin[/i] is also on sale too! So, if you enjoy cheerful action-RPGs or arcade-style action shooters, definitely don't miss out on any of these titles while the sale is still live!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/Gurumin_A_Monstrous_Adventure/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/Gurumin_A_Monstrous_Adventure/[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/305980/Heavy_Fire_Afghanistan/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/305980/Heavy_Fire_Afghanistan/[/url]

[b]SAVE EVEN MORE BY PICKING UP THE HEAVY FIRE + RELOAD TRIPLE PACK!
[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/]https://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/[/url]

Plus, during the Steam Lunar New Year Sale, qualifying purchases over $30.00 will receive an automatic discount of $5.00! How cool is that?! Thank you, Steam! :lunar2019smilingpig:

[h1][b]WIN A $25 AMAZON GIFT CARD![/b][/h1]
Yup! We're giving our fans a chance to win a $25 Amazon gift card by participating in the Mastiff 2019 Customer Survey! Click the image below to start the survey and help us continue to deliver the best possible service and the best games at the best prices in 2019 and beyond!

[url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/mastiff2019survey][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/bacd020db6c4fe47dcc6f3d286e8516a0a908521.png[/img][/url]

We love to hear from you! So if you're on [url=http://facebook.com/mastiffgames/]Facebook[/url] or [url=http://twitter.com/mastiffgames/]Twitter[/url], please don't hesitate to give us a shout. 

Well, that about wraps it up for now. 
Thank you for all of your support, and keep being awesome!

- Your pals at Mastiff :parin:

Pick it up today from [url=https://www.gamestop.com/nintendo-switch/games/party-planet-only-at-gamestop/153904]GameStop[/url],

...and don't miss a gaming beat! Join the newly launched [b][url=http://mastiff-games.us16.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=6122b594701351cd90cec94f3&id=c2ac6614d3]Mastiff Newsletter[/url][/b] to stay up to date on upcoming releases, sales, giveaways, and more!

notes.title: No Coal in Here, Just Winter Sale Savings!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/f8d7d82894f69fdb8c5a6099fc0aca1543169bd1.png[/img]

It's the most wonderful time of the year! 
That's right, it's time again for the Steam Winter Sale! 

From now through January 2, 2017 you can save on the critically-acclaimed action-RPG, [b]Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure[/b] and other high-action titles from Mastiff like [b]Heavy Fire: Shattered Spear[/b], [b]Heavy Fire: Afghanistan[/b], and [b]Reload[/b], which was recently used in a [url=http://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/0956797615579274]case study[/url] published by the Association for Psychological Science on how "Cognitive Training Can Reduce Civilian Casualties in a Simulated Shooting Environment." It's quite an interesting and insightful read -- we highly suggest checking it out when you get a few minutes to spare.

You can also pick up all three shooters in the [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/]Heavy Fire + Reload Triple Pack[/url][/b] at an even bigger discount!

Get in on the savings!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/385600/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/305980/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/330370/


And if you're looking for RPG action on the go, Gurumin is now available around the world in the Nintendo eShop for the 3DS! You can purchase it directly from your 3DS or from  [url=http://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/gurumin-3d-a-monstrous-adventure-3ds]HERE[/url]! 

Check out what press have been saying about Gurumin 3D:

[url=https://twitter.com/Gurumin3D/status/811366563756421120][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/719e2e3ef439e85e50b22209d6bd3f4d44f69740.png[/img][/url]

We also have several themes available in the Theme Shop that you can use to decorate your 3DS with. Each theme features unique art, game folders, and music straight from the game!

So if you've been good all year long why not treat yourself to some gaming goodness? Go on, you've earned it! And perhaps you're looking for a last minute gift for a friend too. Well, they do make for great digital stocking stuffers - consider sharing the joy by gifting any one of these titles to a friend!

Thanks for all of your support. 

[b]Happy Holidays & Happy New Year. We'll see you in 2017!

-Mastiff[/b]

And if you're looking for RPG action on the go, Gurumin is now available around the world in the Nintendo eShop for the 3DS! You can purchase it directly from your 3DS or from  [url=http://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/gurumin-3d-a-monstrous-adventure-3ds]HERE[/url]! 

Check out what press have been saying about Gurumin 3D:

[url=https://twitter.com/Gurumin3D/status/811366563756421120][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/719e2e3ef439e85e50b22209d6bd3f4d44f69740.png[/img][/url]

We also have several themes available in the Theme Shop that you can use to decorate your 3DS with. Each theme features unique art, game folders, and music straight from the game!

So if you've been good all year long why not treat yourself to some gaming goodness? Go on, you've earned it! And perhaps you're looking for a last minute gift for a friend too. Well, they do make for great digital stocking stuffers - consider sharing the joy by gifting any one of these titles to a friend!

Thanks for all of your support. 

[b]Happy Holidays & Happy New Year. We'll see you in 2017!

-Mastiff[/b]
